title: Beauty and Brownie
author: Ellen C. Babbitt
summary: 两只鹿带群迁往高山，美美谨慎无损，布朗尼大意折损大半。
publicDomainBasis: Retold by Ellen C. Babbitt and published in 1922 by The Century Co. (pre-1923, public domain in the United States); Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: Two Deer named Beauty and Brownie lived with their father and mother and great herds of Deer in a forest. One day their father called them to him and said: "The Deer in the forest are always in danger when the corn is ripening in the fields. It will be best for you to go away for a while, and you must each take your own herd of Deer with you."
paragraphs.zh: 两只鹿，一只叫美美，一只叫布朗尼，跟着父母和一大群鹿住在森林里。有一天，父亲把他们叫到跟前说：“田里的玉米快熟时，森林里的鹿总是很危险。你们最好出去躲一阵子，各自带上自己的鹿群。”

paragraphs.en: "What is the danger, Father?" they asked.
"When the Deer go into the fields to eat the corn they get caught in the traps the men set there," the father said. "Many Deer are caught in these traps every year."
paragraphs.zh: “鹿到田里吃玉米时，会被人在那儿设的陷阱夹住，”父亲说，“每年都有很多鹿被夹住。”

paragraphs.en: "Shall you go away with us?" Brownie said.
paragraphs.zh: “你和我们一起去吗？”布朗尼问。

paragraphs.en: "No, your mother and I, and some of the other old Deer will stay here in the forest," said the father. "There will be food enough for us, but there is not enough for you and your herds. You must lead your herds up into the high hills where there is plenty of food for you, and stay there until the crops are all cut. Then you can bring your herds back here. But you must be careful.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我和你们的母亲，还有一些年老的鹿留在这儿，”父亲说，“我们的食物够了，可不够你们和你们的鹿群吃。你们要把鹿群带到高高的山里去，那里食物充足，待到庄稼全收完再回来。不过你们一定要小心。

paragraphs.en: "You must travel by night, because the hunters will see you if you go by day. And you must not take your herd near the villages where hunters live."
paragraphs.zh: “你们必须夜里赶路，因为白天走会被猎人看见。也不要把鹿群带到猎人住的村子附近。”

paragraphs.en: So Beauty and Brownie and their herds set out. Beauty traveled at night and did not go near any villages, and at last brought his herd safely to the high hills. Not a single Deer did Beauty lose.
paragraphs.zh: 于是美美和布朗尼带着各自的鹿群出发了。美美夜里赶路，不靠近任何村庄，最后把鹿群平安带到高山。美美一只鹿也没丢。

paragraphs.en: But Brownie forgot what his father had said. Early each morning he started off with his herd, going along all through the day. When he saw a village, he led his herd right past it. Again and again hunters saw the herd, and they killed many, many of the Deer in Brownie's herd.
paragraphs.zh: 可布朗尼忘了父亲的话。每天一大早，他就带着鹿群出发，整天赶路。看见村庄，他竟带着鹿群从村边经过。猎人一次又一次看见鹿群，打死了布朗尼群里许多许多的鹿。

paragraphs.en: When crops had been cut, the Deer started back to the forest. Beauty led all his herd back, but stupid Brownie traveled in the daytime, and again he took his herd past the villages. When he reached the forest only a few were left of all Brownie's herd.
paragraphs.zh: 庄稼收完后，鹿群动身回森林。美美把整群鹿都带了回来，可愚蠢的布朗尼白天赶路，又带着鹿群从村庄边经过。等他回到森林时，布朗尼的鹿群只剩下寥寥几只。
